name: Oxyphenbutazone Anhydrous

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 7 other countries, first in 1984 — for blood problems and serious skin reactions

summary: Oxyphenbutazone Anhydrous was pulled from the market in the United States and seven other countries starting in 1984 because of blood problems and serious skin reactions [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received a high score for liver concerns [M]. The same computer model gave the drug a low score for heart concerns [M].
